claims.text: The AWSx ELB component provides APIs for provisioning Application and Network Load Balancers and integrates with API Gateway, ECS, Lambda, and VPC.
The example AWSx load balancer listens on port 80 in the account's per-region default VPC using its public subnets, exposing it to the internet.
ALBs automatically open ingress traffic to the ports they listen on, whereas NLBs do not.
The Pulumi AWS registry has API docs for the aws.ec2 LaunchTemplate resource at /registry/packages/aws/api-docs/ec2/launchtemplate/.
When the load balancer's target group is passed in an ECS task definition's portMappings, AWSx uses that target group to populate the ECS service's load balancer configuration.
The AWSx ECS component (awsx.ecs classes) automatically creates the right ingress and egress rules; raw aws.ecs requires manual security group rule management.
The ECS Fargate example program exports a stack output named `url` used by `pulumi stack output url`.
ALBs offer two features that make them more attractive than NLBs for ECS: dynamic host port mapping and path-based routing with priority rules.
By default, an AWSx load balancer is created internet-facing, using the VPC's public subnets.
Setting the `internal` property to true makes the load balancer private.
AWSx load balancers accept either a `subnets` property (subnet objects) or a `subnetIds` property (subnet IDs).
NLBs support TCP, TLS, UDP, TCP_UDP, QUIC, and TCP_QUIC protocols, while ALBs support HTTP and HTTPS; NLBs default to TCP.
AWS docs URLs rule-action-types.html#fixed-response-actions, #redirect-actions, and listener-rules.html exist for the ELB documentation.
deregistrationDelay range is 0–3600 seconds and default is 300.
slowStart range is 30–900 seconds or 0 to disable, and it is disabled by default.
Stickiness is supported for ALBs only.
targetType values are instance, ip, lambda, and alb, default instance; IP targets must be within VPC private range, RFC 1918 ranges, or RFC 6598 range 100.64.0.0/10.
Health check interval range is 5–300 seconds with default 30 seconds.
healthyThreshold range is 2–10 with default 3.
unhealthyThreshold range is 2–10, default 3, and for NLBs must equal healthyThreshold.
Health check timeout range is 2–120 seconds; AWS default is 6 seconds for HTTP target groups and 10 seconds for HTTPS, TCP, and TLS target groups.
